title: How to organise the folding surface | Laundry Room
description:
Turn a finished dry load into clothes that are back in drawers the same day.

This is the Folding Surface in the Laundry Room. About 15-30 min.

WHAT DONE LOOKS LIKE
A counter bare enough to roll pastry on, one empty basket per bedroom stacked underneath it, six spare hangers on the rail at the end, and no clean clothing anywhere in the room.

THE SIX PASSES
Sort: Clear the counter right down, including everything that was never laundry: the post, the toolbox, the parcel w
Straighten: Keep one basket per person or per bedroom under the counter, so folding and delivering are the same motion rat
Shine: Wipe the counter before you fold, not after.
Safety: If you iron on this counter, the iron gets one heatproof rest and the cord runs behind it where no arm can hoo
Standardize: The counter is either completely empty or holding exactly one load in progress.
Sustain: Tip the basket out onto the counter rather than setting it down full.

THE STANDARD YOU LEAVE BEHIND
The counter is bare or holding one load, and every basket under it is empty before bed.

Full written steps for this zone, free:
https://6s-success.com/zones/laundry-room-the-folding-surface.html

6S Success turns Lean's six-S method into something you can actually do in a house: Sort, Straighten, Shine, Safety, Standardize, Sustain. One small zone at a time, finished in one session, and it stays finished.
